"version":"1","OUTFITS_V1":[{"id":"o4","why":"Answers the 'statement' intent with a defined silhouette (Navy/White split) and loud accent (Terracotta bag) to draw eyes while maintaining comfort for dancing; fixes shoelessness by adding black loafers from showcase."],"pole":"filter_and_rank|anchor_first|tonal_column|ease_the_knot","items":["#163·31","#47·32","#360·03","#125·07"],"day":"A navy blue fitted top paired with straight-leg jeans and a terracotta bag creates a cool-toned base for autumn evening events; added black loafers provide stability for dancing, while the orange bag offers the necessary loud accent to satisfy her goal of being watched.","deliberate":[{"item":"#163·31","why":"This 'edge' branch item defines the silhouette and formality better than the alternative set.","finding":"f-o4-2"},{"item":"#47·32","why":"The 'break' branch and straight cut provide a readable silhouette letter for dancing comfort.","finding":"f-o4-6"},{"item":"#360·03","why":"The terracotta bag provides the loud accent colour needed to draw the eye away from the belly zone.","finding":"f-o4-3"}],"done":[{"finding":"f-o4-1","action":"fixed"},{"finding":"f-o4-2","action":"fixed"},{"finding":"f-o4-3","action":"fixed"},{"finding":"f-o4-6","action":"fixed"},{"finding":"f-o4-8","action":"declined","why":"The navy and white split creates a strong vertical line that anchors the look; the coordination score is improved by this deliberate separation rather than merging colours."}]},"needed":[{"kind":"shoes","description":"Black loafers needed to finish the jeans ensemble and provide stability for dancing.","type":"loafers","color":"black","fabric":"suede"}]}
